title: Protein language model guides creatinase stability optimization
summary: A deep protein language model used prior single- and multiple-mutant measurements to guide combinations across two design/test rounds. The 13-substitution variant 13M4 reportedly retained nearly wild-type catalytic activity and increased apparent melting temperature by 10.19 °C. This assay does not establish long-term stability across production conditions, and the model recombined previously measured mutations.

evidence.tested: Publisher article and PubMed metadata report 13M4, near-WT catalytic activity and apparent melting-temperature increase.
evidence.unknown: Prior exact-sequence reporting and independent replication not established.
evidence.ai_role: Protein language model guided combinations of previously tested mutations for experimental stability and activity assays.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
